## Progress

- Open [PR #83](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/83): SignalR board hub at /v1/hubs/board. Connecting needs "Check-in & queue" at the session's facility (capability policy; a refusal is audited Denied). Every call re-checks the live staff session, and Watch joins only the session's own facility after the board's access check, audited Allowed or Denied and limited per user. Groups are tenant + facility ids from the session. Messages are `{appointmentId, state, changedAt}` only (exact-field allowlist test); boards refetch the audited board endpoint
- The hub has no write methods: call-in and every status move stay on the audited HTTP endpoints with the visit state machine (409) and the in-transaction audit. Call-in records the room of the doctor's session from the template ("Called to Room 3"). After the commit, moves and bookings are pushed; a failed push never fails the move
- Client: reconnect with back-off; refetch after every (re)join, so a move is never lost or duplicated; "Live updates paused · refreshing every 30 s" (words and icon) with 30 s polling while not live; no connection while offline; stops on 401/403. Mutation-checked (13 server, 6 client); a change reaches another desk within 2 s (SQL Server, LongPolling and WebSockets); browser-verified with two signed-in desks (en, ar RTL, keyboard, axe, reconnect after killing the connection)
- Left: close hub connections at once when a session is revoked (MDV-P0-012); Azure SignalR Service before running more than one API instance (MDV-P0-007); Today views (P2) subscribe when they exist

## Description

SignalR hub scoped per tenant+facility pushes board changes to all open boards and Today views. "Call in" assigns a room and changes state; wait timers update live ("Waiting 12 min"). Reconnect logic resyncs state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A state change on one device appears on another device's board within 2 seconds.
- [ ] **AC2.** Hub connections are authorised per facility; a user cannot subscribe to another facility's board (security test).
- [ ] **AC3.** After a network drop the board resyncs without duplicates or lost moves.
- [ ] **AC4.** Messages carry ids and nonclinical fields only.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
